meta.homeTitle: Screenshot (App) Maker — Gukora amafoto ya App Store byoroshye
meta.homeDescription: Kora amafoto ya App Store meze neza kandi yiteguye koherezwa, ukoreshe Ollama kugira ngo ukore amandike mu rurimi rw'igihugu mu buryo bworoshye.
meta.ollamaDescription: Huza Screenshot (App) Maker na server yawe ya Ollama kugira ngo ukore localization y'amafoto ukoresheje AI mu buryo bwizigirwa kandi bwihariye.
meta.privacyDescription: Menya uburyo Screenshot (App) Maker ibika amafoto yawe, imihindure, n'imikorere ya localization mu buryo bwihariye.

features.titleHtml:
Koresha igihe gito mu gutegura.
Sohora ibikora byawe wizeye kurushaho.
features.description: Screenshot (App) Maker ihindura imirimo isubiramo itangira mu gusohora app, ikayigira nk'imigendekere imwe y'amaso kandi isobanutse.

cards.title: Shyiramo amafoto y'ibice bya app yawe.
cards.body: Zana amafoto (screenshots), uyishyire mu miterere y'ibikoresho iteye neza, kandi utegure inkuru yuzuye ya App Store mu minota mike.

cards.title: Kora igenamiterere rimwe.
cards.body: Shyiraho amabara, imiterere, ibyerekeye ibikoresho, uburyo bwo kwandika, n'ibishishwa kuri buri paji, ariko ugumya ubutumwa bwa buri paji bwihariye.

cards.title: Kora ibihuye na buri screen.
cards.body: Tegura ibikoresho bya iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, Apple TV, n'amafoto y'ingenzi (feature graphics) ukoresheje umushinga umwe.

cards.title: Sohora ikirango cyiteguye koherezwa.
cards.body: Kora amafoto afite ireme ryo hejuru, utegure amadosiye ahinduye ururimi, kandi uhuze amakuru ya App Store yahinduwe mu ndimi zitandukanye mu kazu kamwe gasobanutse.

localization.ariaLabel: Icyitegererezo cyo guhuza ururimi cya Ollama
localization.pill: Gishyizwe mu kazi na serivuzi yawe ya Ollama
localization.title: Kampayi yawe y'amafoto (screenshots), itegurewe kuvugira buri soko.
localization.description: Huza Screenshot (App) Maker na Ollama hanyuma uhindure imyandikire y'amafoto n'amakuru ya App Store mu nzira imwe. Imiterere yawe isanzwe igumana uko ari, mu gihe amagambo ahinduka bijyanye n'ururimi rw'igihugu.
checks: Huza ibisobanuro, amagambo y'ingenzi (keywords), n'inyandiko zishimangira itangaza ry'impinduka n'ururimi rw'igihugu
Sura ibyashyizwe mu rundi rurimi mbere yo kubisohora bwa nyuma

workflow.title: Shyiramo amafoto y'ibanze. Uyobye ibikoresho byiteguye ku isoko.
workflow.description: Nta gutegura imishusho bigoye. Nta gusubiramo gukora gahunda imwe kuri buri rurimi.

steps.title: Injiza
steps.body: Shyiramo imbuga zigaragaza neza ibyo app yawe ikora.

steps.title: Kurema isura no guhindura mu rurimi

steps.title: Sohora

privacy.title: Ibikoresho bya app yawe biguma mu bushobozi bwawe.
privacy.description: Guhindura amafoto (screenshots) bikorwa kuri gikoresho cyawe. Iyo uhisemo Ollama, amagambo yohererezwa gusa aho wateguye itumanaho rya server.

final.overline: Kuva ku mafoto (screenshots) kugeza ku kohereza
final.title: Kora intambwe ya nyuma mu buryo bworoshye.

ollama.title: Inyigisho yo gutegura Ollama
ollama.subtitle: Huza Screenshot (App) Maker n'uburyo bwawe bwa Ollama kugira ngo ukore guhindura ururimi hakoreshejwe AI no kurema inyandiko.
requirements: Imashini ya Mac, Windows PC, cyangwa Linux yo gukoresha Ollama
iPhone/iPad yawe kuri network imwe n'imashini ya Ollama (birashimwa)
steps: Shyiraho Ollama: manura hanyuma ushyireho Ollama kuri OS yawe.
Tangiza Ollama: koresha ollama serve (cyangwa fungura app ya Ollama kuri macOS).
Kuzana model: koresha ollama pull llama3.2 (cyangwa model wifuza).
Menya ko bikora: koresha ollama run llama3.2 hanyuma ugerageze prompt.
Shaka adresi ya serivuri yawe: andika LAN IP ya mudasobwa yawe (urugero 192.168.0.10).
Byikoreshe muri app: muri Screenshot (App) Maker settings, shyira Host kuri http://<LAN-IP>:11434.
notes: Niba app itashoboye guhuza, reba niba telefone yawe na mudasobwa ziri kuri Wi-Fi imwe.
Menya neza ko port 11434 yemewe na firewall yawe.
Niba wishimira gukoresha serivuri yo kure (home PC, VPS), ugomba gufungura port mu buryo bwizewe (VPN irashimangirwa).
ollama.ctaBody: Garuka muri app, gerageza guhuza, hanyuma utangire n'ururimi rumwe.
ollama.metaTitle: Inyigisho zo gushyiraho Ollama — Screenshot (App) Maker

privacy.title: Politiki y'ibanga
privacy.intro: Iyi Politiki y'ibanga isobanura uburyo Screenshot (App) Maker ("App") itunganya amakuru y'umukoresha.
summary: Nta makonti. Nta isuzuma. Nta gukurikirana.
Amadosiye yawe n'ibyo wahinduye biguma ku gikoresho cyawe, keretse niba uhisemo guhuza na server yawe ya Ollama.
Niba ukoresha Ollama, inyandiko yohererezwa gusa ku adresi ya server wateguye.

sections.title: Gukusanya amakuru
body: Iyi App ntigukusanya, ngo ibike, cyangwa yohereze amakuru y'umuntu ku ma server yacu.
Screenshots, templates, n'amafoto yasohowe bikorwa kandi bikabikwa mu gikoresho cyawe.

sections.title: Kwinjira mu Mafaili n'Amafoto
body: Iyi App ishobora gusaba uburenganzira bwo kwinjira muri app y'amafaili cyangwa mu bufunguzo bw'amafoto yawe kugira ngo izane screenshots.
Amafoto yazanywe akorwaho mu gikoresho kandi ntabwo yohererezwa hanze mu buryo bwikora.

sections.title: Guhindura ururimi hakoreshejwe AI (Ollama)
body: Niba wemeje gukora cyangwa guhindura inyandiko hakoreshejwe AI, iyi App ishobora kohereza inyandiko kuri server ya Ollama wateguye (urugero, mudasobwa yawe).
Ntituyobora cyangwa ntukira imyandiko yawe ya Ollama, kandi iyi App ntabwo ibika cyangwa isubiza inyandiko zakozwe na AI.

sections.title: Serivisi z'abandi
body: Iyi App ntiyikoresha serivisi z'abandi zo gusesengura, SDK z'itangazo, cyangwa ikoranabuhanga ryo gukurikirana.

sections.title: Impinduka
body: Tushobora guhindura iyi Politiki y'Ubwizerwa kenshi. Impinduka zizagaragara kuri iyi paji.

sections.title: Kumenyerana
body: Niba ufite ibibazo bijyanye na Politiki y'ibanga, nyandikire kuri imeyili yashyizwe mu rutonde rwa App Store.
